hypothesis: Frozen morphology detector scores on identical saved vector bags may depend on observed-RGB component grouping and relative placement; append-only detection may not transfer to near/context placement.

mapping.additions: complete cached host RGB foreground union verified saved donor PNG foreground at recorded coordinates
mapping.replacement: unchanged native host component carriers, not observed donor piece identity

selection: No fitting, threshold selection, primary switch, new donors or changed eligibility. Reuse original 35 method/fold records and fit-slide centroid references. Strict score > threshold; unavailable context abstains. Influence explains visual flags without veto.
pairing: task/condition/control/host/donor/seed/dose; all complete append/near/context triplets fixed from old eligibility before detector scoring; retain mapping abstentions as misses
metrics: All-case and common-triplet fragment/tile recall, alerts, source-following native cancer flags, clean damage, originally-correct induced-error recovery; S1 cosine and S2 logit influences separate. Conditional host bootstrap 2000 draws seed 20261023, never a patient-population interval.
limitations: Training-only exploratory engineering audit; two unique hosts per task, repeated doses/seeds and donor reuse; no independent validation or verified patient identities.
S2 scorer is fitted on training hosts; apparent robustness is resubstitution evidence, not held-out disease performance.
RGB topology uses bounded level-2 host foreground and rasterized saved PNGs. Topology and physical context can change together; do not claim a pure causal distance effect.
Replacement evaluates native component carriers and may mix donor and host vectors; it does not measure recognition of a physically separate foreign fragment.
Four clean anchors cannot validate population burden. Historical 72-slide cross-fit clean results remain the prior development reference; no thresholds are recalibrated here.
Known annotated native cancer is a negative control for foreignness. An influential or flagged component is not evidence of contamination. No tissue is removed.
All 327 previous exclusions remain excluded despite the numeric geometry validator fix; no outcome-guided eligibility revision.
No GPU, new data, model training, calibration or final-test predictions. Existing rejected final-test protocol remains blocked.
